title.en: Flight delay notice with fake support number
title.es: Aviso de retraso de vuelo con número de soporte falso

lure: A SkyBridge Airlines delay notification for a named traveler, timed to a real-world outage event. The email offers a 'Check Flight Status' button (lookalike domain) and a fake customer-support phone number that connects to a scammer.
audience: All Fernhollow Outfitters employees; especially effective for frequent business travelers
review_notes: Spanish text written by Claude; have a native speaker review tone and regional phrasing before use with learners.
The phone number cue relies on stress and timing (outage news) rather than obvious visual errors — brief facilitators on that before deployment.
